checkRuns.command: grep -n "ActionError" node_modules/kay/types/runtime/index.d.ts | head -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun src/server.ts"; sed -i 's|    "fmt": "kay fmt"|    "fmt": "kay fmt",\n    "test": "bun test"|' package.json && bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3 && git status --short && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3
pgrep -af "server.ts"; grep -n test package.json; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3 && git status --short && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3

sed -i 's|    "fmt": "kay fmt"$|    "fmt": "kay fmt",\n    "test": "bun test"|' package.json && grep -n '"test"' package.json && rm -rf .kay && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun test 2>&1 | tail -3
(PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
for p in / /books /books/treasure-island /books/x /about /contact /x; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4702$p) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/o)"; done
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'asset %{http_code}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:4702$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4702/books | grep -o '/_kay/entry-[^"]*' | head -1)"
kill $(pgrep -f "^bun src/server.ts") ; sleep 1; pgrep -af "src/server.ts" | grep -v pgrep || echo "server stopped"

cp src/routes/about.kay /tmp/about.bak; printf -- '--- server
const n: number = "x"
---
p {n}
' > src/routes/about.kay; bun run check 2>&1 | head -5; cp /tmp/about.bak src/routes/about.kay; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short src/routes/about.kay

otherRuntimes:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/islands.test.ts'
s=open(p).read()
a=s.index("it('filters the books by tag'")
b=s.index("it('marks favorites from localStorage'")
c=s.index("it('shows every contact error")
s=s[:a]+s[b:c]+s[a:b]+s[c:]
s=s.replace("  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50))\n  console.log('stored', JSON.stringify(Object.entries(localStorage)))\n","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun test 2>&1 | tail -6
